name: Multi Display Adjustment
description:
Offers per-display sliders to control external displays' brightness and contrast through DDC/CI. Each connected display gets its own labelled pair of sliders in Quick Settings.
Extension requires ddcutil-service to be installed. Installation process of ddcutil-service is quick and non-intrusive. The details can be found at https://github.com/samuelcecilio/multi-display-adjustment#installation-of-ddcutil-service. ddcutil-service allows more responsive communication with the displays than ddcutil.
